approval.description: draft until it is posted or asked for; awaiting_approval while a request to post it waits; approved once posted; rejected when the latest request was rejected and it is still a draft.

due.description: overdue once its due date has passed while it is posted and not paid in full; not_due otherwise.

ledger.description: not_posted, posted, or voided by a reversal.

payment.description: What has been paid of it, from the payments and credits applied to it net of their voids (FR-AR-18): unpaid, part_paid or paid; for a vendor credit, what is applied of it to bills. scheduled and written_off arrive with payment batches and write-offs.
